title_en: Doctors and Pharmacies (12/20): The Pediatrician Examines Xiao Bao
note_en: The pattern 一边……一边…… shows two actions happening at the same time: 她一边跟小宝说话，一边轻轻检查他的耳朵 "She talked to Xiao Bao while gently checking his ears." English uses one "while" or "as"; Chinese puts 一边 in front of each verb, and both actions should be things a person can do at once.
